vocabulary.definition: commit or agree to do something
vocabulary.example: Uruguay undertakes to build a new stadium for the occasion.

vocabulary.definition: organizations formed by the coming together of smaller organizations or groups
vocabulary.example: Europe the players and federations have little interest in this event.

vocabulary.definition: make a formal judgment or decision about a problem or disputed matter
vocabulary.example: The referee agrees to adjudicate the match only if he is protected.

vocabulary.definition: competition for the same objective or for superiority in the same field
vocabulary.example: The Cup final is played between Uruguay and Argentina whose rivalry is so strong.

vocabulary.definition: discussion aimed at reaching an agreement
vocabulary.example: After many negotiations, only four European countries agree to participate.

vocabulary.definition: a particular time or instance of an event
vocabulary.example: The World Cup would take place in 1930 on the occasion of the Centenary.
